description: Allowlisted read-only inventory for the AI tool update digest. No entry authorizes an update.

tools.name: Pi CLI
tools.risk_reason: Pi core changes extension and model loading behavior.
tools.rollback_note: Reinstall the recorded exact npm version or restore the previous user binary.

tools.name: Pi-signed / Pi Launcher
tools.risk_reason: Signed launcher and credential supervision boundary.
tools.rollback_note: Keep the prior cask artifact and restore the exact app version after approval.

tools.name: Pi web access
tools.risk_reason: Pi extensions run with full system access.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact Pi package pin in the test profile.

tools.name: Pi Codex fast mode extension
tools.risk_reason: Extension behavior can alter agent sessions.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the previous Pi package pin.

tools.name: Pi OpenAI compaction
tools.risk_reason: Unversioned agent extension is pinned by commit.
tools.rollback_note: Repoint the Pi package settings to the recorded commit.

tools.name: Ponytail
tools.owner: Pi git package and Claude plugin
tools.risk_reason: It changes agent instructions and plugin behavior.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the recorded Pi commit and Claude plugin checkout.

tools.name: Pi FFF
tools.owner: Nix/Home Manager or Pi package manager
tools.risk_reason: Active ownership is split between a Nix pin and a Pi package.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the recorded Nix closure or exact Pi package version after owner selection.

tools.name: Pi Autoresearch
tools.risk_reason: It can run experiments and hooks with agent privileges.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact Pi package version.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.owner: Native installer and Homebrew cask collision
tools.risk_reason: The active native launcher and declared cask are different owners.
tools.rollback_note: Preserve the native versions directory and prior cask artifact; choose one owner before updating.

tools.name: Claude Code Homebrew cask
tools.risk_reason: The Homebrew cask may differ from the active native Claude launcher.
tools.rollback_note: Choose one Claude owner and preserve the other version before changing the cask.

tools.name: Codex CLI
tools.risk_reason: Standalone runtime and model behavior can change.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the prior standalone release directory and current symlink.

tools.name: OpenCode
tools.risk_reason: Inventory-only runtime with separate plugin wiring.
tools.rollback_note: Keep and restore the prior binary; do not use it as an implicit Pi fallback.

tools.name: no-mistakes
tools.risk_reason: Updating it can reset the shared pipeline daemon.
tools.rollback_note: Preserve the old binary and daemon state; never update or restart from this collector.

tools.name: Automic Vault app and av
tools.risk_reason: Signed app and CLI are a credential boundary and currently mismatch.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the previous cask/app and signed CLI stub as a pair.

tools.name: Memtrace
tools.risk_reason: Repair/update commands can reset runtime state.
tools.rollback_note: Reinstall the recorded exact npm version and restore the Pi package path.

tools.name: m87
tools.owner: Nix/Home Manager and npm global collision
tools.risk_reason: Nix and user npm currently disagree about the owner.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the Nix closure or exact npm package only after owner selection.

tools.name: Herdr
tools.risk_reason: FirstMate worker placement and protocol behavior are version-gated.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the previous Homebrew keg or direct binary and verify protocol compatibility.

tools.name: Treehouse
tools.risk_reason: No stable machine-readable release source or checksum contract was verified.
tools.rollback_note: Keep the previous binary or installer artifact.

tools.name: gh-axi
tools.risk_reason: It wraps GitHub operations.
tools.rollback_note: Install the recorded exact npm version from the existing npm cache.

tools.name: lavish-axi
tools.risk_reason: It runs a local browser editor/server.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact npm version.

tools.name: quota-axi
tools.risk_reason: Update check is read-only; normal quota reads are credential-adjacent.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact npm version.

tools.name: chrome-devtools-axi
tools.risk_reason: It controls a browser and its MCP launcher.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact npm version and re-check the tracked MCP launcher.

tools.name: tasks-axi
tools.risk_reason: Native update check is unsupported; registry metadata is used instead.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the exact npm version.

tools.name: linear-axi
tools.risk_reason: Configured and installed repository identities disagree.
tools.rollback_note: Pin a verified commit after the captain resolves identity.

tools.name: GitHub CLI
tools.risk_reason: Nix owns the active binary.
tools.rollback_note: Rebuild the prior Nix profile.

tools.name: Headroom
tools.risk_reason: Output wrapper behavior affects agent sessions.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the prior pipx environment.

tools.name: RTK
tools.risk_reason: Output wrapper behavior affects agent sessions.
tools.rollback_note: Restore the prior Homebrew keg.

tools.name: Skills CLI and generated skills
tools.owner: Mutable npx and public git sources
tools.risk_reason: Generated instructions/code execute in agent contexts without a complete pin ledger.
tools.rollback_note: Archive generated skills before refresh and restore the archived copies.

tools.name: Model catalogs
tools.risk_reason: Catalog drift must never switch the selected model.
tools.rollback_note: Preserve the captain's explicit runtime model and environment.
